title: AI assistant
subtitle: Helps you plan, but changes nothing without your confirmation.

disabled.title: The assistant is not connected.
disabled.hint: The server admin needs to set AI_ENABLED and an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Everything else works as usual.

demo.title: Demo mode.
demo.hint: The assistant runs without a connected Claude model: it understands simple requests — free time, a plan for tomorrow, tasks, events, habits, goals, the week’s results — and answers from your data. For open conversation the server admin needs to set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

welcome.title: How can I help?
welcome.hint: Ask about free time, have it draft a day plan, or capture a task.

consent.title: What AI may read
consent.hint: The assistant sees only the areas you choose, and only when it needs them for an answer. Journal and wellness only if you turn them on explicitly.

scopeHint.TASKS: Task titles, due dates and statuses

examples.title: For example:
examples.plan: Plan tomorrow around my free time
examples.task: Add a task: prepare the seminar slides
examples.free: When do I have two free hours this week?

disclaimer: AI can be wrong. Every change shows up as a draft first — check it before confirming.

errors.AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: AI is unavailable right now. Everything else works — try again later.
errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: Could not put an answer together. Try rephrasing.
errors.AI_REFUSED: The assistant can’t help with this request.

context.none: The AI did not read your data for this answer.
